root_idea.summary: The root centers on spaciousness, expansion, and the provision of room or scope.
root_idea.development: Its uses develop from physical spaciousness and widening into making room for others, mutual accommodation, latitude for action, and figurative expansion of the chest or field of vision.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form فَسَحَ rather than the inflected QAC forms.
Displayed under the normalized Form V perfect citation form تَفَسَّحَ.

senses.definition: To make room or give space to someone; to accommodate another by spreading out or withdrawing.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of making room in an assembly or sitting place, with لِـ marking the person accommodated. The construction can also express granting someone room or latitude, as in Allah’s making room for the believers.

senses.definition: To make room, spread out, or expand so that others have space.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of mutual or self-directed expansion in an assembly or sitting place; in the Quranic construction, people are told to make room for one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become spacious, roomy, wide, or ample.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use, especially of a place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Widening the spaces between steps or between successive needle punctures.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of spacing or widening, including the spacing of punctures when sewing a water-skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A written pass or travel authorization.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional administrative or travel document, compared with a jawāz.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a place spacious, roomy, wide, or ample.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II usage, applied to a place rather than necessarily to a person being accommodated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To range at large or expatiate; to have ample room or scope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical use of Form V beyond the Quranic assembly instruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the resting place of camels to become spacious, meaning that the camels have become numerous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic, figurative use associated with a camel resting place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the bosom or chest to expand with joy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative Form VII usage describing inner elation or relief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the eye to have an unobstructed view, with nothing hindering distant sight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form VII construction concerning the range of vision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Spaciousness, roominess, width, or ample scope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of the ground, and also of having ample scope for action in an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two hairless spaces on either side of the hair growing immediately beneath the middle of the lower lip.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a place, including a sitting place or assembly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broad-minded and free from distress or narrowness of mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pace or manner of travel in which the steps are wide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of broad-stepping movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having ribs that are wide apart or broadly expanded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A description specifically attested of a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ample scope or a place in which one has room to act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for having no ample scope in a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An expanded or opening place in a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of the place where a valley broadens.
An anatomical noun recorded as a distinct lexical use.
